title: Expose invertible fitted standardization statistics
body:
## Problem

Standardizer.parameters tests for mean/std attributes, but fit stores _mean/_std. A fitted instance therefore reports both statistics as None and inverse_transform fails with TypeError. Zero-variance training features also retain a zero scale and produce nonfinite transformed values.

## Change

Expose the fitted attributes through parameters, and use unit scale for zero-variance features. This preserves finite forward transforms and permits reconstruction of the original values, including held-out data whose previously constant feature changes.

## Validation

`PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest numpy_ml/tests/test_standardizer_statistics.py numpy_ml/tests/test_preprocessing.py::test_standardizer -q`: 10 passed.

The nine new cases give eight failures and one passing control on unchanged master b0359af. They cover all four centering/scaling configurations, ordinary and constant columns, stored statistics, training and held-out data, inverse reconstruction and an unfitted control. Forward results are compared with sklearn StandardScaler.

Native Python 3.9.25, NumPy 1.26.4 and scikit-learn 1.6.1. Black checks on the modified source region and new tests, plus git diff --check, pass. The full repository suite was not rerun.
